description: Implement an automated release system that publishes updated packages to npm when changes are merged to main. The system should handle version bumps, changelog updates, and coordinated publishing of multiple packages with shared dependencies.
functional_requirements: Automatically create release PRs when changesets are added to the main branch
Update package versions and changelogs for all affected packages when the release PR is merged
Publish updated packages to npm registry with proper dependency resolution
Handle patch updates for packages with shared dependencies like @astrojs/underscore-redirects
Ensure all package.json files are synchronized with correct version numbers
Update lockfile to reflect new package versions across the monorepo
